**Definition** (`Formula`). The formulae of $\mathcal L$ are generated by: $P(t_0,\dots,t_{n_P-1})$ for a relation symbol $P$ and terms $t_i$; $\varphi\dot-\psi$; $\neg\varphi$; $\tfrac12\varphi$; and $\sup_x\varphi$ for a variable $x$. There is no separate $\inf$; it is defined in `FormulaConnectives`.
